title: Long and Short, Heavy and Light
seo_title: Length, Weight and Capacity – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Compare two or more things by length, height, weight and capacity; use longer, shorter, taller, heavier, lighter, holds more. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: longer and shorter, taller, heavier and lighter, and which holds more. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Line them up at one end
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Line things up at the same start.
  • The one that goes further is longer or taller.
  • On a balance, the heavy side goes down.

Examples

Example

A pencil and a ruler start at the same place. The ruler goes further.

The ruler is longer

Answer: The ruler

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Not starting at the same placeLine up the ends first.
Thinking big means heavyA big balloon is light. Use a balance.
Mixing up tall and longTall is for standing up. Long is for lying down.
